explication: TickerQ is a .NET background-job scheduler and workflow system, with optional dashboard, persistence, integrations, and centralized Hub packages. The main workflow is to register and schedule work, manage and execute it, persist its state, then inspect or monitor the outcome. The README documents package capabilities and several relationships; sampled source is limited, so undocumented runtime links are omitted.
